review_pr: run a coordinated math and engineering review on a Lean 4 pull request with parallel reviewers
create_math_reviewer: create a MathReviewer agent to review mathematical correctness and proof validity of Lean 4 formalizations
create_engineering_reviewer: create an EngineeringReviewer agent to review code quality, style, and structure of Lean 4 code
build_system_prompt_math: build a system prompt for the MathReviewer adapted to sketcher, prover, fix, scan, triage, or maintain agent types
parse_review_response: parse an LLM review response string into a verdict, summary, and list of line-specific comments
